transport.parent_action_definition: for each layer and tensor family, delta_W_parent = W_parent_with_endpoint_frame - W_parent_identity

transport.inference_only_override: install exact cached c_fc/c_proj materialized weights for evaluation, then discard them

decision_rule.materialized_action_portable: additive_materialized_full clears the mean gain threshold and is nonnegative on both windows

decision_rule.component_supported: the one-sided component is nonnegative on both windows and recovers at least half the full-action mean gain
decision_rule.raw_coordinate_control: raw_endpoint_coordinates must reproduce the prior nonportable sign; otherwise stop for evaluator identity drift

next_action_binding.materialized_action_portable: fit or parallel-transport the materialized action into a deployable fixed chart before any causal training run
